tools.title: Related Rates: Sliding Ladder
tools.intro: The foot of a ladder slides away from the wall at a steady rate. Watch how fast the top slides down, and find out why that rate keeps changing.
tools.description: Slide the foot of a ladder away from a wall at a chosen rate and watch dy/dt, the angle rate and the area rate update from 2x·dx/dt + 2y·dy/dt = 0. See why the top speeds up near the ground and where the triangle is largest.
tools.discovery: Differentiating x² + y² = L² with respect to t links the rates: dy/dt = −(x/y)·dx/dt. A constant dx/dt gives a changing dy/dt that grows without bound as y → 0, and the area x·y/2 is largest where x = y.

tools.title: Particle Motion: Position, Velocity and Distance
tools.intro: A particle moves along a line with a velocity you choose. Watch its position, the signed area under v, and the distance it travels.
tools.description: Run a particle along a number line from a velocity function and a starting position. Link the position graph to the signed area under v, see when it changes direction and when it speeds up, and compare displacement with total distance.
tools.discovery: x(t) = x(0) + ∫₀ᵗ v(u) du; displacement is the signed area under v and total distance is the area under |v|. The particle turns where v changes sign and speeds up when v and a have the same sign.
